method: Direct visual inspection of the nine predeclared static PNG sheets through image display; no new native read, browser capture, metric computation or fit.
recommendation: Retain light-inactive E3 for the single exposure within its uniform-body claim; do not infer whole-material or structured-backdrop closure.

readings.observation: Light-active control: Candidate looks unchanged from Shipped; the native body hue/level, inner-edge treatment and dark contour remain different.

Claimed light-inactive uniform body: Candidate visibly approaches native hue/level and the amplified interior difference nearly disappears. The native dark perimeter is still missing; the remaining bright difference outline is not a body closure.
Dark-active control: Candidate looks unchanged from Shipped; the grey web body does not carry the native olive hue, and perimeter/rim differences remain.
Dark-inactive control: Candidate looks unchanged from Shipped. The native dark contour and hue/level are still visibly different.
Light-inactive gradient diagnostic: Candidate reduces interior difference bands, but the native contour and structured residuals remain. This does not establish a spatial law.

Canonical 1x light-inactive photo diagnostic: broad colour/level matching improves, notably the right green/yellow region. Candidate still carries mottled structure against the smoother native body; perimeter differences remain.

Canonical 2x small photo diagnostic: changes are mixed locally. Some amplified difference patches appear brighter than Shipped, while colour placement changes. This is not a blanket photographic improvement or a G2 metric verdict.
Canonical dark-active control: Candidate looks unchanged from Shipped; the native inner edge and the web perimeter/shadow treatment remain different.
Frozen macOS26.5 photo control: Candidate looks unchanged from Shipped. Existing muted chroma, structured interior and perimeter/shadow differences from native remain.

limitations: Nine predeclared examples supplement the complete866-sheet inventory; not a per-pixel review of every cell.
No G2 M1/M2/L1, canonical holdout or production-CSS adoption claim.
Identity language here is visual; machine byte identities are separately established by capture/scoring evidence.

spatialMechanismHypothesis.status: hypothesis only; not tested or fitted in this gate
spatialMechanismHypothesis.observation: On the1x photo, E3 removes the broad shipped hue/level band but introduces visible mottling at the backdrop texture period; native is smoother. On the2x small photo, some local amplified residual patches are brighter than shipped.
spatialMechanismHypothesis.mechanism: The existing E3 shader evaluates L and interpolated g(L) per pixel on vitrea’s blurred backdrop. A hypothesis is that local luma variation is amplified into chroma variation, whereas the native body behaves as if the law argument were smoother: a larger blur scale or group-level luma. This is the S1 blend versus blur question, not an identification of Apple’s implementation.
spatialMechanismHypothesis.followUp: A separately declared spatial bed must vary group mean and backdrop frequency and carry structured holdout. G2’s canonical M1/M2/L1 referees remain load-bearing before any landing.
